get.summary: Get content system data mapping candidates
get.description: Get the curated data a mappable element property may be mapped to, keyed by the root source a layout is bound to. The catalogue is an allowlist rather than a projection of the entity schema: only a path listed here is admitted by the content layout write boundary.

200.description: Returns the mapping candidates of every registered root source.

mappingCandidates.description: Keyed by root-source id. Every registered root source carries an entry; a source that offers nothing mappable carries an empty array, so a client never has to tell "no candidates" apart from "unknown source".

path.description: The dotted path into the layout's root-ambient data, including its leading context key ("category.name"). This is stored as the mapping consumer's sourcePath.

label.description: Snippet key for the human-readable name; the Administration resolves it against the user's locale.

description.description: Snippet key for the supporting line rendered under the name.

group.description: Grouping id the Administration renders as a section in the selection modal, for example "basic", "seo" or "media".

valueType.description: The effective type the property receives, after any projection has run: a primitive ("string", "integer", "number", "boolean") or a fully qualified class name. Filter candidates against a property's declared type with this, not with the type sitting at the path.

contextType.description: Whether the candidate yields a single value or a collection.

projection.description: Name of the projection adapting the resolved value to valueType, or null when the value at the path already has that type. Informational: the server applies it, the client only echoes it back when storing the mapping.

labelTranslations.description: Literal localized labels supplied by a dynamic candidate's configuration. The Administration prefers these over label when present.

descriptionTranslations.description: Literal localized descriptions supplied by a dynamic candidate's configuration. The Administration prefers these over description when present.
